item.title: Show HN: Orbit - AR satellite tracker, watch 15k+ objects (Source: hnrss.org | Category: Hacker News)
item.description: Hey HN! I made Orbit, an iOS app that allows you to see the satellites, planets, and constellations above you in AR, on a 2D map, and on a 3D globe. The app includes more than 15,000 objects tracked by CelesTrack, together with their pass predictions, descriptions, and detailed orbital data. A searchable catalog of all objects is also available, as well as a built-in chatbot designed to answer any space-related questions you might have. This is my first published iOS app, so any feedback is greatly appreciated! App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6772174570 Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48873501 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
